title: Libraries Looked Emptier While Digital Borrowing Hit 739 Million
hook: Library visits fell, but digital borrowing hit 739 million.
closing: Readers did not disappear; libraries followed them onto their phones.
question: How do you borrow books?

segments.say: Library visits fell to 671 million, making buildings look quieter even while demand survived.
Digital checkouts reached 739 million, proving library use moved online instead of disappearing.
